segments.spoken_text: A neat meeting summary can still invent the next step.
Here is a made-up meeting note: check the room. Nobody has agreed who will do it.
This deliberately faulty draft assigns a person and a deadline. Neither appears in the note.
Ask for three fields: action, owner, and due date. Missing information should stay visibly unknown.
Then compare each row with the original note. AI prepares the draft; the meeting owner checks it.
If ownership is missing, ask the team. Do not let a tidy table make the decision.
Only the confirmed version becomes the action list. Keep the source note beside it.
Try this on a fictional note first: can you spot what was never agreed?
